summary: Reconciliation/design-only phase (no implementation, no gate code changed, no retroactive promotion of Phase 149O.20L.7O.2P, no Git history rewritten). Resolved two documentation defects before 2R implementation. Issue 1: PROJECT_STATUS.md/CHANGELOG.md's 149O.20L.7O.2P entry said 'Not pushed,' which had gone stale -- fresh Git evidence this phase (git fetch, then git merge-base --is-ancestor for all nine 149O.20L.7O.2P commits against origin/main) confirms they are origin-reachable as ancestors of 149O.20L.7O.2Q's own separately governed and successful push (2Q was built directly atop 2P's already-committed local history). Corrected the prose to distinguish three independent facts using frozen vocabulary (commit_reachability: origin_reachable; phase_push_ceremony: not_attempted -- pcae push was never invoked naming 2P; canonical_report_state: quarantined -- three .blocked artifacts under .pcae/phase-reports/quarantine/, confirmed fresh this phase, never promoted). 2P is explicitly NOT retroactively promoted, pushed, or reclassified as complete. Issue 2: 2Q's recommended_next_phase field misstated the structured fast_green verification invariant as 'cannot be used to pass a report the scalar-form gate would reject' -- literally false, since passing exactly such raw-nonzero, zero-attributable-regression reports is the structured path's entire purpose. Corrected (frozen, normative, Section 27 of the reconciliation doc): the structured path may accept a scalar-rejected raw-nonzero report only when machine-produced evidence independently proves every structured acceptance invariant. Also froze, ahead of 2R: the five-bucket raw-count conservation invariant as an exact disjoint union with no residual (Section 7); baseline authority (true phase-entry commit, programmatically derived, Section 9) and candidate authority/freshness rules (Section 10); pre-existing/environment/expected-phase-artifact classification rules requiring machine evidence, not narration (Sections 11-13); the attributable-failure fail-closed default (Section 14); a push-ceremony circularity analysis confirming the dependency graph is not actually circular -- the existing --stage-pending-report two-phase protocol (project_phase_completion_procedure.md steps 8-10) already resolves the apparent HEAD==origin/main circularity (Section 21); a quarantined-ancestor policy recommendation -- allow commit transport (rejecting a hard block as disproportionate), preserve report quarantine, and require later pushes to additively surface (never launder) a quarantined ancestor's phase-trust state (Section 22-23), confirmed via direct inspection of src/pcae/commands/push.py that no such check currently exists (accidental, not designed, behavior); deselection-masking prohibition (Section 17) and test-inventory-drift handling (Section 18); and a corrected, narrowed scope for 2R (Section 26). Full document: docs/PHASE_149O_20L_7O_2Q_1_QUARANTINED_ANCESTOR_PUSH_STATE_AND_ATTRIBUTION_GATE_CONTRACT_RECONCILIATION.md.
